settings.heading: Soda, minus the sugar crash.
settings.lede: Most sodas are a list of things you cannot pronounce. We wanted a can you could explain to your grandfather.
settings.image_alt: A hand holding a cold can of Fizz against a sunny sky
Cans of Fizz cooling in a stream on a picnic day
settings.heading: Soda got complicated for no good reason.
settings.text: Walk down any aisle and half the labels read like a chemistry exam. We think a daily can should use ingredients you trust, taste like fruit you would rather be eating and cost about the same as a coffee.

settings.quote: “I started with a juicer, a few botanicals and a stubborn idea that soda could taste like summer and still feed your good bacteria.”
settings.note: Founder placeholder text: the person who began with a kitchen test batch and grew it into a nationwide fizz.
